# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:**

The text is almost entirely lost. No continuous spiritual sense can be recovered from these remn ants.

---

**¶2:** … the whole of the spiritual fac ulties together … that they shall… the full ness of the inner fac ulties of the mind — for * seven people* corresponds to the complete array of living capac ities within the regener ating person — … and again , this one principle among them … in the state when … belonging to wisdom … the whole of the spiritual person… is opened to perception from within … and what is opened is received up ward into wisdom … entirely , according to the very essential quality of that principle as it subs ists in itself … and from this, three remaining interior powers …

---

## Translator 's Note

This passage surv ives only as a r uin. What can be disc erned is this : it speaks of the complete set of interior faculties (* seven people*) through which wisdom (* light *) flows into the whole person (*the universe*). Something is * revealed* — that is , an interior state is opened to conscious spiritual perception — and through that opening the person is carried further into wisdom (* take to the light*). The * three * remaining principles likely correspond to a triad of essential capac ities — possibly love , understanding , and out ward life — but the surrounding context that would confirm this is lost .

Where fragments resist confident translation, I have rendered the bare spiritual grammar visible rather than in vent what the lac unae have taken .
